title: BioIVT LUPUS/RA result fields use a shared canonical list (deduplication only, no CDASH standard)
description: Points every field currently typed select_one result or select_one rares at the shared canon_result_code list. This is a within-Detroit duplication, not a Precision/Detroit case: Detroit's LUPUS form (12 fields) and RA form (5 fields) independently defined the identical Positive/Negative/Unknown list under two different names. Targeted by field.type rather than field.name since the 17 field names have no common naming pattern.
rationale: BioIVT canonical-code-list-library project. No CDASH codelist governs a generic result flag -- sponsor-defined. Values already identical (1/0/U -> Positive/Negative/Unknown), pure deduplication.
source: BioIVT_DataMastering_FeasibilityReport.docx Option C recommendation; canonical-code-list-library plan step 1c

history.note: First convention targeted by field.type rather than field.name, since LUPUS/RA result field names have no shared pattern. Verified all 17 target fields are select_one (no select_multiple cardinality conflict) before writing this.
